feedback:
Approved because no model actions remain this iteration, so a revision could not be reviewed and then raced. The candidate matches the iteration 7 best (688.5) on every field: kp 2.8, kd 0.9, ki 0, base_speed 1.1, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss 'last_direction', sensor_size 0.012 and the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024 to 0.024 m). All values are inside the contract. This nothing-new resubmission is the only way this iteration gets a scored race. Nothing here predicts how it will perform.

Evidence behind the approval: iteration 7 was the best raced design. Its oval finished 20 of 20 and its s-bend 20 of 20. Its slalom still finished 0 of 20, with max_error 0.0618 and 1.05 line-loss events per run. Iteration 8, which changed only sensor_size to 0.016, fell to 610.4, with s-bend completion dropping to 13 of 20 and the slalom unchanged. So the wider footprint is ruled out as a slalom fix. Speed, spread, kd, kp and sensor_size have each been tested, and slalom max_error has stayed between 0.061 and 0.064.

What to do with the next iteration, depending on the race. Test one untested slalom lever at a time, starting from this design. Hold the oval and s-bend completions (20 of 20 and 20 of 20 at iteration 7) as the constraint. If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 and its line_loss_events stay near 1, try the remaining untested options below.
requested_changes: If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with line_loss_events near 1, test geometry.sensor_size 0.008 with the iteration 7 spread and the other fields held. The 0.016 footprint was tested in iteration 8 and hurt the s-bend (13 of 20), so the smaller footprint is the remaining edge-sharpness test.

If the slalom still fails with sensor_size 0.012 or 0.008, test a forward sensor offset by changing geometry.sensor_positions y from 0.04 to 0.06 for all sensors, keeping the x values and sensor_weights. Forward position gives the robot more lead time on the tape, and the y position has not been tested in any iteration. Spread changes (iteration 5) and sensor_size changes (iteration 8) did not clear the slalom.

Keep geometry.sensor_positions at x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m and base_speed at 1.1 unless a race shows a clear reason to change them. Iteration 5 widened the spread to ±0.03 m and cut the score from 555.0 to 513.3, so do not return to the wider array without new evidence.
